audit.whatIsWrong: The single most exploitable rule in Lillia's kit was absent: her ultimate does not work on a clean target. Riot's text — 'Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy' — means dodging her spells removes her 150s ultimate from the fight entirely.
audit.why: The page instead told the reader to 'bait her Lullaby', which invites you to eat a spell in order to bait it. Not taking Dream Dust is strictly better and is a positioning rule you can follow every wave.
audit.corrected: Written into report[5].t, phases[4].why and spikes[2].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability-name errors. packet flagged wants.foe[2] writing 'Lullaby' for Lilting Lullaby. Separately wants.foe[1] calls the seed poke 'W (Watch Out!)' — the seed is Swirlseed (E, 700 range, 12s); W is a nearby AoE with no seed at all.
audit.why: Data Dragon: Q Blooming Blows, W Watch Out! Eep!, E Swirlseed, R Lilting Lullaby. A reader spacing against the wrong slot spaces against the wrong range.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0] is titled 'Bank W's refund for his poke rotation' but its body describes her kiting speed.
audit.why: Her passive deals max-health damage over time off any spell hit, which is exactly the chip Locke's W refund is designed to absorb.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d rewritten to match its title and name the passive's max-health tick.
